## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL regime; Breadth: 10/11 sectors positive. Tech is a clear outlier (Tech breadth: 3/19 positive → Sector Weakness) while most cyclical and defensive sectors show strength, producing mixed internals and a Neutral call.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Communication lead: CHTR (1W: +22.63% | 1M: +6.75%) ABOVE TREND, VZ (1W: +19.28% | 1M: +18.88%) ABOVE TREND, T (1W: +13.09% | 1M: +11.45%) ABOVE TREND. Consumer Staples strong: TGT (1W: +12.18% | 1M: +11.78%) ABOVE TREND, PEP (1W: +11.91% | 1M: +18.77%) ABOVE TREND. Energy strength: XOM (1W: +7.28% | 1M: +17.73%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +6.65% | 1M: +10.61%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Technology lagging: MSFT (1W: -14.00% | 1M: -12.41%) BELOW TREND, NVDA (1W: -9.05% | 1M: -7.40%) BELOW TREND, AMD (1W: -20.79% | 1M: -9.45%) BELOW TREND — Tech breadth: 3/19 positive → Sector Weakness. Consumer Discretionary in Internal Rotation: AMZN (1W: -4.12% | 1M: -0.03%) BELOW TREND, TSLA (1W: -5.90% | 1M: -10.11%) BELOW TREND. Financials showing internal rotation: JPM (1W: +5.49% | 1M: -4.59%) RECOVERY, but pockets of weakness exist.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: CHTR (1W: +22.63% | 1M: +6.75%) ABOVE TREND, VZ (1W: +19.28% | 1M: +18.88%) ABOVE TREND, DOW (1W: +16.63% | 1M: +30.12%) ABOVE TREND, FDX (1W: +15.22% | 1M: +21.88%) ABOVE TREND, T (1W: +13.09% | 1M: +11.45%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Narrow (3/5 Communication) — leadership concentration is a caution flag.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: ACN (1W: -10.64% | 1M: -8.46%) BELOW TREND, CRM (1W: -12.51% | 1M: -22.17%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: -14.00% | 1M: -12.41%) BELOW TREND, NOW (1W: -14.31% | 1M: -24.75%) BELOW TREND, PYPL (1W: -24.13% | 1M: -30.80%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in Technology and select payments names.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Top 1W momentum: CHTR (1W: +22.63%), VZ (1W: +19.28%), DOW (1W: +16.63%), FDX (1W: +15.22%), T (1W: +13.09%). Major divergence: several large-cap tech names (MSFT, NVDA, AMAT) are breaking down while breadth is wide — this is a MAJOR divergence and warrants tactical caution.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Technology mixed but overall weak; AAPL (1W: +7.82% | 1M: +3.45%) ABOVE TREND sits against broad tech selling: MSFT (1W: -14.00% | 1M: -12.41%) BELOW TREND, NVDA (1W: -9.05% | 1M: -7.40%) BELOW TREND. Tech breadth: 3/19 positive → Sector Weakness.

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials internally rotating: JPM (1W: +5.49% | 1M: -4.59%) RECOVERY, V (1W: +0.91% | 1M: -6.74%) RECOVERY, MA (1W: +6.17% | 1M: -2.50%) RECOVERY, but payments/fintech (PYPL (1W: -24.13% | 1M: -30.80%) BELOW TREND) show outsized weakness. Financials breadth: 14/20 positive → Sector Strength.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthcare showing strength with selective leadership: JNJ (1W: +2.96% | 1M: +14.76%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +8.14% | 1M: +6.30%) ABOVE TREND, PFE (1W: +3.56% | 1M: +8.18%) ABOVE TREND, though UNH (1W: -6.16% | 1M: -19.33%) BELOW TREND faces negative sentiment. Healthcare breadth: 11/15 positive → Sector Strength.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor cyclicals and staples showing confirmed strength (e.g., XOM (1W: +7.28% | 1M: +17.73%) ABOVE TREND, TGT (1W: +12.18% | 1M: +11.78%) ABOVE TREND, CAT (1W: +7.55% | 1M: +12.55%) ABOVE TREND) and reduce exposure to large-cap Tech names under pressure (MSFT (1W: -14.00% | 1M: -12.41%) BELOW TREND, NVDA (1W: -9.05% | 1M: -7.40%) BELOW TREND). Style: mixed / no clear leadership given narrow top-five concentration.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: CHTR (1W: +22.63% | 1M: +6.75%) ABOVE TREND, PEP (1W: +11.91% | 1M: +18.77%) ABOVE TREND, JNJ (1W: +2.96% | 1M: +14.76%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment-confirmed. BEARISH: MSFT (1W: -14.00% | 1M: -12.41%) BELOW TREND, NVDA (1W: -9.05% | 1M: -7.40%) BELOW TREND, PYPL (1W: -24.13% | 1M: -30.80%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Communication (6/7 positive → Sector Strength), Consumer Staples (10/12 positive → Sector Strength), Energy (7/8 positive → Sector Strength). BEARISH: Technology (3/19 positive → Sector Weakness), Consumer Discretionary (6/11 positive → Internal Rotation).

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
NVDA: watch for stabilization and reclaim of 1M trend to signal relief; MSFT: confirm downside if follow-through below this week's lows; AAPL: continued ABOVE TREND momentum would be needed to offset broader tech weakness; PYPL: monitor for further downside pressure given steep 1W/1M declines.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
JNJ (+80): JNJ (1W: +2.96% | 1M: +14.76%) ABOVE TREND — news (new approvals) confirming price strength. PFE (+55): PFE (1W: +3.56% | 1M: +8.18%) ABOVE TREND — positive trial data confirming move. PEP (+55): PEP (1W: +11.91% | 1M: +18.77%) ABOVE TREND — earnings beat confirming accumulation.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
UNH (-80): UNH (1W: -6.16% | 1M: -19.33%) BELOW TREND — DOJ probe headline confirming downside. NEM (-50): NEM (1W: -11.44% | 1M: +12.87%) CORRECTION — bearish headlines but 1M strength create a divergence (trend exhaustion). ACN (-50): ACN (1W: -10.64% | 1M: -8.46%) BELOW TREND — negative sentiment confirming recent breakdown.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL regime, style mixed / no clear leadership; Breadth: 10/11 sectors positive. CHTR, VZ, DOW, FDX, T showing clear strength (all ABOVE TREND). Key risk: concentrated leadership (Narrow: 3/5 Communication) and large-cap Tech breakdown (MSFT, NVDA, ACN) — major divergence to monitor, reinforced by negative headlines for UNH and ACN.
